tier_reason: Upgraded C->B: peer-reviewed paper (Tolmachev, IEEE Access 2023, DOI 10.1109/ACCESS.2023.3242240) reports the A100/CUDA 11.7 and MI250/ROCm 5.2 FP64 comparison vs cuFFT/rocFFT; benchmark harness (VkFFT_TestSuite, -vkfft 1001 / -cufft keys) is public in the repo, but compiler and flags are not stated, so not A.

corrections.claimed_speedup: README plot (FP64 batched 1D C2C, A100): radix 2-13 lengths are at parity (~1250-1280 GB/s for both VkFFT and cuFFT); for Rader primes VkFFT reaches ~400-1250 GB/s vs cuFFT ~250-630 GB/s, and for Bluestein VkFFT beats cuFFT (cuFFT Bluestein drops to ~100-180 GB/s above length 2048), i.e. roughly 1.5-3x on non-smooth lengths (derived from page data). Paper: Bluestein 'faster than either cuFFT and rocFFT'.
corrections.caveats: Baseline cuFFT/rocFFT is a GPU incumbent, not in the category list. Speedup applies to non-power-of-2/prime lengths; radix 2-13 lengths are at parity with cuFFT. First-party author measurements (peer-reviewed). Compiler/flags unstated. Last commit Feb 2024 (v1.3.4). Precision: with FP128 twiddles VkFFT is more precise than cuFFT/rocFFT in FP64; with FP32 twiddles slightly less precise in Bluestein/Rader.

notes: Plots read from benchmark_plot/fp64_cuda_a100.png; kept README as benchmark_url. Paper read via scispace PDF mirror (IEEE page https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/10036080/ not opened). MIT, 1.8k stars, not fork/archived.
